findings.message: Unsupported: "An opponent was dealt 7 or more damage this turn" cannot be said. The amount is DamageDealtThisTurn, whose To must name a player to act on, and AnOpponent - the only reference that means "some opponent" - is refused there (L041). EachOpponent would read "every opponent", which is a different card in a multiplayer game, and ChoosePlayer or TargetPlayer would invent a choice the card does not print. No Condition asks how much damage a player was dealt this turn, so the gate on the play permission has no spelling and the MayPlay cannot be written without it.
